nodes.description: Chain id of the chain where the relay is deployed; decides whether XY tokens are locked/burned or released/minted.
Treasury address that receives cross chain fees and can propose a new treasury.
Two-step transfer target for the treasury role.
Supervisor contract that holds validators and verifies multi-signatures.
XY token contract that is locked, burned, released or minted by the relay.
Upper bound on the amount allowed in a single cross chain request or completion.
Monotonic counter used as the id of newly created cross chain requests.
Mapping sourceChainId => requestId => bool used as replay protection for completed requests.
Initializer setting chain id, treasury, supervisor, xyToken, max amount and roles.
Internal helper pulling XY tokens from the sender and burning them when not on ETH chain.
Internal helper that transfers or mints XY tokens to the receiver and the treasury fee.
Treasury-only function proposing a new treasury address.
Pending treasury accepts the role and becomes the new treasury.
UUPS upgrade authorization hook restricted to ROLE_OWNER.
Owner-only function to sweep ERC20 tokens accidentally sent to the contract (XY token excluded).
Manager-only function that pauses the contract.
Manager-only function that unpauses the contract.
Manager-only function updating the maximum cross chain amount.
Staff-only function that validates supervisor signatures and releases/mints XY tokens for a cross chain request.
Public function that locks the caller's XY tokens and creates a new cross chain request id.
Caller address; controls access control checks and is the source of funds and receiver of rescued tokens.
External token transfer from the sender into the relay inside _lockXYToken.
External burn call on the XY token when this chain is not the ETH chain.
External token transfer to receiver/treasury performed in _releaseXYToken on the ETH chain path.
External mint call to receiver/treasury performed in _releaseXYToken on non-ETH chain path.
External call into the Supervisor contract that recovers signers and enforces the validator threshold.
UUPS implementation upgrade that performs a delegatecall to the new implementation.
Cross chain request id from the source chain used as replay-protection key.
Chain id of the source chain indexing the completed request mapping.
Receiver of the XY tokens on this chain in completeCrossChainRequest.
Amount of XY tokens of the completed request, checked against maxCrossChainAmount.
Fee denominated in XY token paid to the treasury, must be smaller than amount.
Validator signatures forwarded to Supervisor.checkSignatures.
Destination chain id of a new cross chain request.
Receiver of the XY tokens on the destination chain.
Amount of XY tokens to lock for the cross chain request.
New value assigned to maxCrossChainAmount by the manager.
Address proposed as the new treasury by the current treasury.
Address from which XY tokens are pulled in _lockXYToken.
Amount of XY tokens locked and possibly burned in _lockXYToken.
Address that receives the released/minted XY tokens in _releaseXYToken.
Amount released or minted to the receiver in _releaseXYToken.
Fee released or minted to the treasury in _releaseXYToken.
amount minus fee, locally computed in completeCrossChainRequest before releasing tokens.
Encoded identifier keccak256 hash of the completed cross chain request payload.
EIP-191 signed message hash of sigId passed to the supervisor for verification.
Id assigned to a new request from numCrossChainRequests++ in requestCrossChain.
